booth.name: VAR Booth
booth.text: 94th minute of the cup final. The home side has just scored. The away side is screaming offside. Twelve screens in front of you. Eleven work. The one with the key angle shows only static.
booth.pundit: PUNDIT: Day one on the job and the footage is already missing. You love to see it.

actions.label: Go to the Referee's Dressing Room
Go to the Mascot Changing Room
actions.blocked_text: The door is locked. A sign says: 'Whistle for entry.'
actions.text: You blow the Lucky Whistle. The door creaks open.

actions.label: Go to the Press Room
actions.text: You follow the sound of camera clicks.

actions.label: Go to the Pitch
actions.blocked_text: Security blocks the tunnel: 'Talk to the press first, mate.'
actions.text: You walk out under the floodlights.

dressing_room.name: Referee's Dressing Room
dressing_room.text: (placeholder) Muddy boots and a half-eaten orange.
dressing_room.pundit: PUNDIT: Snooping in the ref's room. Bold. Pointless, but bold.

actions.label: Take the Lucky Whistle from the bench
actions.text: You pocket the Lucky Whistle. It feels... lucky.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You hurry back to your screens.

mascot_room.name: Mascot Changing Room
mascot_room.text: (placeholder) Pombo the pigeon mascot sits on a bench, looking guilty.
mascot_room.pundit: PUNDIT: Asking a pigeon for evidence. This is why I love football.

actions.label: Ask Pombo what he is hiding
actions.text: Pombo coos and drops a USB Stick into your hand.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You hurry back to your screens.

press_room.name: Press Room
press_room.text: (placeholder) A wall of microphones points at you.
press_room.pundit: PUNDIT: Careful now. One wrong word and you're a meme.

actions.label: Say: 'Clearly a goal!'
actions.text: Cameras flash. Somewhere, a VAR rulebook bursts into flames.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You escape before anyone asks a question.

pitch.name: The Pitch
pitch.text: (placeholder) 60,000 fans are waiting. The referee looks at you.
pitch.pundit: PUNDIT: Here we go. Decision time for the rookie.

actions.label: Back to the VAR Booth
actions.text: You walk back inside. The crowd boos.
